title: Bonfyre Artifact Manifest
description: Universal typed manifest for Bonfyre artifact families. Every artifact family writes one of these. Supports operator lineage, Merkle hashing, and realization targets.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier for this artifact family instance (slug or UUID).

artifact_type.description: Primary type of the artifact family.

source_system.description: The binary or system that produced this manifest (e.g. BonfyreBrief, BonfyreProof).

tags.description: Free-form tags for indexing and retrieval.

root_hash.description: SHA-256 Merkle root over the operator DAG. Computed by hashing all operator nodes bottom-up.

atoms.description: Base atoms — the irreducible source inputs to this artifact family.

operators.description: Operator nodes in the derivation DAG. Each operator transforms inputs into outputs.

realizations.description: Concrete realized outputs (files or data). Each is either pinned (materialized) or reconstructable from operator + inputs.

realization_targets.description: Declarative list of what CAN be produced from this family (not necessarily materialized yet).

metadata.description: Arbitrary additional metadata specific to the artifact type.

atom_id.description: Unique identifier for this atom within the family.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the atom's canonical content.

media_type.description: MIME type or Bonfyre type (e.g. text/plain, application/json, audio/wav).

path.description: Relative path to the atom file (if materialized).

operator_id.description: Unique identifier for this operator node.

op.description: Operator name (e.g. Clean, Paragraphize, Summarize, Narrate, Trim, Pack).

inputs.description: List of atom_ids or operator_ids that feed this operator.

params.description: Operator-specific parameters (e.g. profile, voice, t0, t1).

node_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of: op + canonical params + sorted child hashes + version.

deterministic.description: Whether this operator guarantees identical output given identical inputs + params.

realization_id.description: Unique identifier for this realized output.

media_type.description: MIME type of the realized output.

path.description: Relative path to the realized file (if pinned/materialized).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the realized content.

pinned.description: Whether this realization is materialized on disk (true) or can be reconstructed from operator (false).

produced_by.description: operator_id that produced this realization (if derived).

op.description: Operator that would produce this target.
